notes.title: ⏳ Release Delay Announcement – Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44790310/73621b8dff81df63500ea399dd84c664af943e2a.png[/img]
Hi everyone,

[h1][b]We’d like to inform you that the release of Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX has been slightly delayed to April 18 at 4PM PST.[/b]
[/h1]
We're adding the final touches and a few last-minute features to ensure the best and most polished experience possible for all of you.

We truly understand your excitement, and we apologize for this short delay. But we believe this extra time will allow us to deliver a much better game for you to enjoy.

🙏 Thank you for your patience and continued support!

With love,
The Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX Team

notes.title: Update version 1.0.1 Claire bug fixes and others...
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce, the game has been updated to version 1.0.1 !!!
New things:
- Fixed Claire health bar display error.
- Balance Claire.
- Added buttons to Epilogue after winning Agenda 4 times.
- Gallery bug fix.
- Improve Hscene, add progress slider and can go to the next step immediately.

Thank you all for reporting us!
Hope you enjoy the game!!!
